relation_to_failed_profile_ablation: This is a distinct distillation structure. The failed E80 aggregate feature bundle remains rejected and is not retuned. Valid out-of-time per-pitch teacher probabilities are reused as soft labels instead of being averaged into nine profile features.

scope.game_type_route: candidate only on R; exact parent C unchanged on F
scope.candidate_complexity: two-component nonnegative convex blend: exact parent C plus one soft-label student

data_rules.source_season_labels_in_artifact: integrity check only; teacher_alpha is fixed to zero

soft_target.definition: 0.5 + physics_teacher_probability - mean(physics_teacher_probability within the completed source season)
soft_target.reason: preserve target-aware physical ranking while removing historical teacher calibration and base-rate drift
soft_target.fit_rows: matched R rows in the listed completed teacher years only

student.feature_policy: retain pitcher_id and all pitch-group-specific TrackMan profile columns because the supervised task is physical-teacher imitation

blend.selection: maximize the minimum 2022/2023 R point gain over exact parent, breaking ties by minimum pitcher-cluster 95% lower gain

requirements: one fixed grid weight has positive R point gain over exact parent in both 2022 and 2023
the same weight has positive R 95% lower gain over exact parent in both years
the same routed candidate has positive full point gain over exact parent in both years
the same candidate has positive R point gain over both honest R anchors in both years
development_gate.on_fail: reject without source-2023 teacher artifact or 2024 student run
development_gate.on_pass: lock weight and recipe before a single 2024 confirmation
